blocks.h2: What Does a Catch Basin Do?
blocks.body: A catch basin is an underground box with a grate on top. It collects surface water from your yard, driveway or downspouts and sends it to a storm line or drainage outlet. The bottom of the box sits below the outlet pipe, so sediment and leaves settle out before the water leaves. When that sump fills, the outlet clogs and the water stays on the surface.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: Signs Your Catch Basin Needs Service

tiles.body: Puddles around the grate long after the rain stops.
Leaves, mulch and grass clippings block water from getting in.
Soil washing into a crack in the basin wall.
When the basin can't take it, water follows the slope.

blocks.intro: In McHenry, wet ground makes surface drainage more important.

items.body: Near the Fox River and the lakes, the soil can stay saturated for weeks. A blocked basin leaves water with nowhere to go.
Many subdivisions use yard and driveway basins to move water off flat or low lots.
Road salt, sand and grit wash into driveway basins every spring.

items.h3: Part of a Dry Basement Plan
items.body: A working basin keeps surface water away from the foundation and takes load off your [sump pump](/mchenry/sump-pumps).

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.answer: At least once a year, ideally in late fall. Yards with lots of trees or sandy runoff may need spring cleaning too.

items.q: Why does my catch basin stay full of water?
items.preview: The outlet pipe is blocked or the ground is saturated.
items.answer: Usually the outlet pipe is clogged or broken. In very wet seasons, high groundwater can also slow drainage. A cleaning and a camera look tell us which.

items.q: Who is responsible for a catch basin in my yard?
items.preview: Usually the homeowner, if it drains your property.
items.answer: If it's on your property and handles your yard or driveway, it's usually yours. Street basins belong to the city.

items.q: Can a blocked basin cause basement water?
items.answer: Yes. Water that pools near the house soaks into the soil and adds to what your sump pump has to handle.

items.q: How much does catch basin repair cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the work. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it needs cleaning, a grate, wall repair or work on the outlet pipe. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
